source_refs.note: Exercise 3.4, Question 6: Exercise 3.4, book page 94: Q1-Q15 (integration by partial fractions); answers book pages 301-302

blocks.explanation:
Is sawal mein denominator mein chaar linear factors hain: \(x\), \(x - 1\), \(x - 2\), \(x - 3\), sab alag alag. Yani yeh bhi Case-I hai, bas factors zyada hain.
Upar degree 2 aur neeche degree 4, to fraction proper hai.
Chaar factors hain to chaar constants \(A, B, C, D\) chahiye.
Plan: ek ek kar ke \(x = 0, 1, 2, 3\) rakhenge; har value par sirf ek term bachega aur ek constant mil jayega.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\int \frac{6x^2 - 22x + 18}{x(x - 1)(x - 2)(x - 3)}\,dx\).
Maloom karna: yeh integral.
Tareeqa: partial fractions, Case-I, chaar linear factors ke saath. Kaam lamba lagta hai lekin har qadam bilkul pichle sawalon jaisa hai.

Partial fractions likhein
\[\dfrac{6x^2 - 22x + 18}{x(x - 1)(x - 2)(x - 3)}\]
\[= \dfrac{A}{x} + \dfrac{B}{x - 1} + \dfrac{C}{x - 2} + \dfrac{D}{x - 3}\]
Kyun: Har alag linear factor ke neeche ek constant. \(x\) bhi ek linear factor hai (yani \(x - 0\)).

Fractions khatam karein
\[6x^2 - 22x + 18\]
\[= A(x - 1)(x - 2)(x - 3) + Bx(x - 2)(x - 3)\]
\[+\, Cx(x - 1)(x - 3) + Dx(x - 1)(x - 2) \quad (1)\]
Kyun: Poore denominator se multiply kiya. Har constant ke saath woh teen factors bachte hain jo us ke apne neeche nahi the. Yaad rakhne ka tareeqa: "apna factor gaya, baaqi teen reh gaye".

(1) mein \(x = 0\) aur \(x = 1\) rakhein
\[x = 0:\ 18 = A(-1)(-2)(-3) = -6A,\ A = -3\]
\[x = 1:\ 2 = B(1)(-1)(-2) = 2B,\ B = 1\]
Kyun: \(x = 0\) par \(B, C, D\) teeno ke saath \(x\) hai, sab zero. \(x = 1\) par left side \(6 - 22 + 18 = 2\), aur sirf \(B\) wala term bacha.
Dhyan dein: Teen negative numbers ka product negative hota hai: \((-1)(-2)(-3) = -6\).

Integral lein
\[\int \left(-\dfrac{3}{x} + \dfrac{1}{x - 1} + \dfrac{1}{x - 2} + \dfrac{1}{x - 3}\right)dx\]
\[= -3\ln|x| + \ln|x - 1|\]
\[+ \ln|x - 2| + \ln|x - 3| + c\]
Kyun: Har term \(\frac{k}{x - a}\) jaisa hai jis ka integral \(k\ln|x - a|\) hai. Chaar terms, chaar logs.

Tasdeeq
\[A + B + C + D = -3 + 1 + 1 + 1 = 0\]
Kyun: (1) ke right side ko kholein to \(x^3\) ka coefficient \(A + B + C + D\) banta hai, aur left side par \(x^3\) hai hi nahi (coefficient 0). Dono barabar nikle, yeh ek tez aur achhi tasdeeq hai ke constants sahi hain.

blocks.text: Kitab ke aakhir mein answers (page 301) mein Exercise 3.4 ke jawab ghalat heading "Exercise 3.6" ke neeche chhape hain. Is sawal ka jawab us block ka item (vi) hai: \(-3\ln|x| + \ln|x - 1| + \ln|x - 2| + \ln|x - 3| + c\). Yeh jawab sahi hai. Jis block par "Exercise 3.4" likha hai (page 301) woh kisi aur exercise ke jawab hain, is liye wahan se milane ki koshish na karein.
